evidence.note: per-worktree attribution of abandoned runs: falls back to the main checkout when work_dir is missing, unattributable, or its nearest ancestor belongs to another repository; never drops a run
scans legacy location before common store and dedupes by id, so a run renamed mid-scan is not missed
layout slice parametrises runsDir/validate/List; NewJSONLStore keeps the 0.13.x layout, NewCommonDirStore uses metareview/runs
end-to-end migration, collision, failure, git clean, worktree-admin-dir and status-pending tests cover the migration surface
StoreDir shared across worktrees, ignores exported GIT_DIR, unaffected by git maintenance and not copied by clone
fromRunRunsDir prefers the common store and falls back to the legacy store with a 0.13 warning

findings.note: Stale comment: ensureRuns still says it creates .metareview/runs, but with the layout slice it creates <root>/metareview/runs for the common-dir store.

TestFSMStoreMigrationFailures restores h.deps.Exec to gate.RealExec rather than the saved `real` value; harmless today because the harness default is the real exec, but it would silently drop a customised seam.

mine() spawns two git processes (StoreDir, Toplevel) per abandoned run found in the shared store, on the Stop-hook path; fine for normal run counts but scales linearly with every worktree's abandoned runs. Could cache by existing-ancestor dir.
